mode: Read-only transcript analysis; no conversation content, images, credentials, or tool-output content included.
method: Streamed the selected file line by line, counted serialized bytes by record type, recognized data:image/*;base64 payloads, and hashed those payloads to count repetitions without decoding or exposing content. Metadata-only inspection of the first record in six large July 21 transcripts.
conclusion: The sampled file is overwhelmingly repeated embedded image payloads in saved compaction history, rather than ordinary conversation text. Fork metadata is present in all six large July 21 files, but duplication across files was not measured.
limitation: This is a complete structural scan of one 2.27 GiB transcript plus metadata-only checks of five other large transcripts. Its percentages must not be represented as measurements of all 52.47 GiB of saved conversations. Existing transcripts were preserved.
